title: Fix a PTT that will not talk
breadcrumb: Fix a PTT that will not talk

slides.title: Allow the microphone
slides.html: If the PTT reads NO MIC after a press, Android has not let OpenDefence Voice use the microphone. Tap Allow microphone.

slides.title: Answer Android's questions
slides.html: Tap While using the app, then Allow for nearby devices and notifications. A Bluetooth headset or PTT button needs nearby devices.

slides.title: Connect ATAK first
slides.html: Connect ATAK to the TAK server first means ATAK is not connected, so ATAK's dot at the map's bottom right is red. Once ATAK connects, OpenDefence Voice connects by itself.
